name: n-exact-sentinel-0-is-absent
reference: spec/engine-spec.md 0.56 `absent` by range and 0.9 table (bits: the len bits as unsigned), msb, word_bytes 1. Input n = 0 (0x000000), x = 0 (0x00). n 0 is the exact sentinel: absent; encode writes the first exact sentinel 0 as 000000. x 0 is below 250: present, 00. Derived by hand.
